sources.title: NPD - Leqtique 9/9 distortion pedal | Rig-Talk
sources.excerpt: 9/9 distortion pedal Thread starter Thread starter scottosan Start date Start date Mar 28, 2026 scottosan Well-known member Mar 28, 2026 #1 Been spending time putting together a pedal board for my 65 Twins Reverb Reissue. I kept coming across a Japanese boutique pedal brand that’s had be curious for a while. I’ve got a lot of bases covered with OD pedals but wanted to try an actual distortion pedal that could turn my TW into a high gain amp. My expectations were low. I started everything at noon and holy fuckballs this pedal is nasty. It has a “bottom” knob in the center position and a smaller knob for highs the typical gain and volume. It also has an internal mid trimmer that I have yet to mess with. The video was writhing 5 minutes of getting it home. Treble and bottom are at noon. The gain and volume are between 9-10:00. I was surprised how good it sounded with no tweaking and either the bright switch engaged on the TR. Also, top notch components. Dale and PRP resistors.
